requirement_evidence_state_chk.name: requirement_evidence_state_chk
requirement_evidence_state_chk.value: ("requirement_evidence"."status" = 'pending' and "requirement_evidence"."state" is null) or ("requirement_evidence"."status" = 'classified' and "requirement_evidence"."state" in ('demonstrated','user_confirmed','missing'))

requirement_evidence_confirm_chk.name: requirement_evidence_confirm_chk
requirement_evidence_confirm_chk.value: "requirement_evidence"."state" is distinct from 'user_confirmed' or "requirement_evidence"."confirmation_text" is not null
